signals.title: EUR/JPY — G10 Bilateral Theme + French Fiscal Turmoil
signals.text: EUR/JPY closed Friday at 177.55 under heavy bilateral pressure as JPY led G10 with a 1W average of +1.076% across 7 pairs while EUR lagged at -0.696% across 9 pairs, generating a critical 1.772% spread. The move is reinforced by French 2027 budget turmoil widening peripheral debt risk, driving EUR/JPY risk reversals to an extreme put skew of -2.42 against a net short EUR leveraged funds positioning of -58.8k contracts. The BoJ meeting on 30 Oct is the catalyst that determines whether Japanese yield support persists against the 121bp OIS carry advantage of the euro. Trade bias: Bearish EUR/JPY into the open; bilateral momentum and European sovereign spread stress override the +121bp EUR carry cushion. Catalyst: BoJ meeting on 30 Oct. Risk: A rebound above the 178.50 zone or sudden easing of French sovereign spread concerns.

signals.title: EUR/USD — Crowded Leveraged Shorts + Post-NFP Repricing
signals.text: EUR COT LF short -58.8k (37.3% long, z=-1.01) creates short-squeeze risk after EUR/USD closed Friday at 1.1254 following the 29k US payroll miss that eliminated October Fed hike pricing. Downside momentum in the pair is stalling as US 2Y spreads against Germany widened 43bp in EUR's favor over 5 sessions, setting up an unwind against retail traders who sit 87% long. The Fed meeting on 28 Oct determines whether the policy pause becomes entrenched. Trade bias: Bullish EUR/USD mean-reversion into the open; collapsing Fed hike odds force an unwind of crowded leveraged shorts. Catalyst: Fed meeting on 28 Oct. Risk: Spot breaking below the 1.1200 psychological handle on renewed European political contagion.

signals.title: AUD/USD — Crowded Long Positioning + Carry Floor
signals.text: AUD COT LF long +55.7k (74.5% long, 81st percentile) creates crowded-long unwind risk after AUD/USD closed Friday at 0.6958 below all major daily moving averages. Downward pressure from broader commodity softness conflicts with the positive 70bp AONIA-over-SOFR carry buffer and an RBA policy rate at 4.60%. The RBA meeting on 3 Nov is the catalyst that determines whether policy divergence can defend the pair against speculative liquidation. Trade bias: Bearish AUD/USD into the open; heavy speculative length leaves spot vulnerable despite the 70bp yield advantage. Catalyst: RBA meeting on 3 Nov. Risk: Spot reclaiming the SMA200 at 0.7032 on broad dollar liquidation.

signals.title: USD/CAD — Extreme Speculative Shorts vs BoC Rate Path
signals.text: CAD COT LF short -49.1k (28.1% long) sets up short-squeeze risk after USD/CAD closed Friday at 1.4255 with retail sentiment reaching an extreme 95% short. The pair's rally into technical resistance above the 200-day moving average faces domestic macro resilience reflected in Canada's positive ESI of +15.6, despite a 159bp SOFR-CORRA carry drag. The BoC meeting on 28 Oct resolves whether Canadian rate hike pricing will accelerate the short covering. Trade bias: Bearish USD/CAD into the open; extreme retail short positioning and solid domestic data cap further upside momentum. Catalyst: BoC meeting on 28 Oct. Risk: Spot breaking cleanly above 1.4300 resistance driven by ongoing crude oil declines.
